name: WavTTS
description: WavTTS is an end-to-end zero-shot text-to-speech framework developed by Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) and ByteDance Seed. It generates speech directly in raw waveform space using flow matching and Diffusion Transformers (DiT), bypassing intermediate mel-spectrogram or neural codec token representations.
keyFeatures: Direct raw waveform modeling via flow matching and Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
Non-overlapping waveform patchification for long audio sequence processing
Multi-scale mel-spectrogram supervision for perceptual training guidance
Zero-shot voice cloning with short reference audio prompts
Built upon the F5-TTS architecture framework
curatorNotes: Verified paper arXiv:2606.03455 and open-source project from SJTU and ByteDance Seed.
institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), ByteDance Seed
